key_methods: initialize(InputInterface, OutputInterface): void -- reads --no-plugins, dispatches PRE_COMMAND_RUN
BaseCommand.plugin_relevance: Reads --no-plugins CLI flag; dispatches PluginEvents::PRE_COMMAND_RUN via EventDispatcher before command runs

Config.role: Holds allow-plugins configuration; persists developer y/n answers via getConfigSource()->addConfigSetting('allow-plugins', ...)

plugin_lifecycle_flow: 1. PluginAuthor creates package of type 'composer-plugin' with extra.class and requires composer-plugin-api
2. Developer adds package to composer.json and sets allow-plugins: {vendor/plugin: true}
4. PluginManager::registerPackage() validates: plugin API version match, isPluginAllowed() check
5. If no allow-plugins rule: Developer prompted interactively (y/n/d); answer persisted to composer.json via Config
6. PluginManager generates autoloader, registers class, instantiates plugin
8. If plugin implements EventSubscriberInterface: registered with EventDispatcher
9. BaseCommand::initialize() dispatches PRE_COMMAND_RUN event (plugins can intercept)
10. On update/remove: deactivate() then uninstall() called in reverse dependency order
authorization_rules: allow-plugins config in composer.json: pattern→bool map (e.g. 'vendor/*': true)
Global plugins checked against allowGlobalPluginRules separately
Legacy lock files (pre-2.2): null rules → prompt or throw RuntimeException
plugin-optional: true in extra → silently skip if not in allow-plugins (no prompt)
Hardcoded block: composer/package-versions-deprecated always returns false
PluginBlockedException thrown if blocked and non-interactive
important_notes: PluginInterface::PLUGIN_API_VERSION = '2.9.0'. Class renaming trick (_composer_tmpN) used when plugin class already loaded to avoid conflicts. Legacy 'composer-installer' type supported for BC. PluginManager can be disabled globally or per local/global scope via --no-plugins CLI flag read in BaseCommand.
